newsitem.title: ITALY: Shots fired at Italian coastguard boat - report.
newsitem.headline: Shots fired at Italian coastguard boat - report.

text.p: Shots were fired at an Italian coastguard boat from a trawler carrying Albanian refugees in the southern Adriatic on Monday, the Italian news agency Ansa reported.

The news agency quoted the commander of the coastguard in the southern port of Brindisi, Capt Giovanni Biso, as saying there were no injuries in the incident. Another coastguard official said he could not immediately confirm the report.
The coastguard official said they were seeking more information on the incident from the captain of the patrol boat. The agency said it occured outside the port of Brindisi.
Brindisi is where many of the nearly 12,000 Albanian refugees have arrived on a flotilla of rusty, old boats since March 13 to escape the chaos in their country.
